<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>MusikPanel</title>
<!--WK76--><!--/WK76-->
<style>
:root{--bg:#0b0816;--bg2:#120d24;--card:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--card2:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--ln:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--txt:#f4f1ff;--mut:#a9a2c7;--a1:#8b5cf6;--a2:#3b82f6;--a3:#ec4899;--ok:#34d399;--bad:#f43f5e;--sh:0 18px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
body[data-th=lajward]{--bg:#050b1a;--bg2:#0a1630;--a1:#3b82f6;--a2:#06b6d4;--a3:#818cf8}
body[data-th=shab]{--bg:#09090b;--bg2:#141210;--a1:#f59e0b;--a2:#ef4444;--a3:#fbbf24;--mut:#b5ab98}
body[data-th=firoza]{--bg:#03131a;--bg2:#062530;--a1:#14b8a6;--a2:#22d3ee;--a3:#a3e635}
body[data-th=anar]{--bg:#14060b;--bg2:#250a14;--a1:#e11d48;--a2:#f472b6;--a3:#fb923c}
body[data-th=yasi]{--bg:#f2ecf8;--bg2:#e6dcf1;--card:rgba(255,255,255,.62);--card2:rgba(255,255,255,.85);--ln:rgba(90,60,140,.13);--txt:#2a1f3d;--mut:#6f6386;--a1:#9b7fc4;--a2:#7c6cd6;--a3:#d48ac0;--sh:0 18px 40px -22px rgba(80,50,130,.45)}
body[data-th=nakhti]{--bg:#fbf3df;--bg2:#f6e7bf;--card:rgba(255,255,255,.6);--card2:rgba(255,255,255,.85);--ln:rgba(120,90,20,.14);--txt:#3b2f12;--mut:#7b6a42;--a1:#d39b16;--a2:#e8b84a;--a3:#c2410c;--sh:0 18px 40px -22px rgba(120,90,20,.45)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%}
body{font-family:Vazirmatn,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);overflow-x:hidden;font-size:15px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-20%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(40% 30% at 85% 5%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 45%,transparent),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(45% 35% at 5% 60%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a2) 30%,transparent),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 30% at 90% 100%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a3) 22%,transparent),transparent 70%),var(--bg);animation:drift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate3d(-4%,3%,0) rotate(4deg)}}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}
input{font:inherit;color:var(--txt)}
img{display:block}
.ae{width:1.25em;height:1.25em;display:inline-block;vertical-align:-.3em;object-fit:contain}
span.ae{width:auto;height:auto;font-size:1.05em;line-height:1;vertical-align:-.1em}
nav button span.ae{font-size:22px}
.wrap{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px calc(170px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 16px;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 60%,transparent)}
header .lg{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -8px var(--a1)}
.brand{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:17px;direction:ltr}
.brand b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a3),var(--a1),var(--a2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
header .sp{flex:1}
.ib{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:19px}
.ttl{font-weight:800;font-size:19px;margin:18px 2px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ttl small{font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);font-size:12.5px;margin-inline-start:auto}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:22px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.sbox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 6px 6px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--ln)}
[dir=rtl] .sbox{padding:6px 14px 6px 6px}
.sbox input{flex:1;background:none;border:0;outline:0;padding:10px 4px;font-size:15px;min-width:0}
.sbox input::placeholder{color:var(--mut)}
.gbtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));color:#fff;border-radius:15px;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px var(--a1);white-space:nowrap}
.gbtn:active,.ib:active,.chip:active,.row:active,.cb:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:12px 0 4px}
.chip{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;transition:.2s}
.chip.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 0 6px;scrollbar-width:none}
.chips::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hint{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin:10px 4px;line-height:1.8}
.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);transition:.15s}
.row .th{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:14px;object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2))}
.row .tx{flex:1;min-width:0}
.row .t1{font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.row .t2{color:var(--mut);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cb{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:16px;flex:none;transition:.15s}
.cb.g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));color:#fff;border:0}
.cb.on{color:var(--a3)}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);padding:28px 16px;line-height:1.9}
.empty .big{font-size:46px;margin-bottom:6px}
.empty .big img{width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto}
/* nav */
nav{position:fixed;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(528px,calc(100% - 28px));display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:7px;border-radius:26px;z-index:30;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg2) 72%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--ln);backdrop-filter:blur(22px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px);box-shadow:0 20px 50px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
nav button{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:6px 0;border-radius:19px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mut);transition:.25s}
nav button .ae{width:26px;height:26px;transition:.25s;filter:grayscale(.55) opacity(.75)}
nav button.on{color:var(--txt);background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 32%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--a2) 22%,transparent))}
nav button.on .ae{filter:none;transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.1)}
/* mini player */
#mini{position:fixed;bottom:calc(86px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(140%);width:min(528px,calc(100% - 28px));z-index:29;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg2) 80%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--ln);backdrop-filter:blur(22px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px);transition:.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);overflow:hidden}
#mini:not(.show){opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#mini.show{transform:translateX(-50%)}
#mini .th{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2))}
#mini .tx{flex:1;min-width:0}
#mini .t1{font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#mini .t2{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
#mini .pl{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a3),var(--a1),var(--a2));width:0}
/* sheets */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:40;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.ov.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.sheet{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:41;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:28px 28px 0 0;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:10px 16px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translateY(105%);transition:.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1);max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto}
.sheet.show{transform:none}
.sheet .grab{width:42px;height:5px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--ln);margin:2px auto 12px}
.sheet h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin:4px 2px 14px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.thg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}
.thc{padding:12px;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid var(--ln);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;background:var(--card)}
.thc.on{border-color:var(--a1)}
.thc i{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;flex:none}
/* full player */
#fp{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:var(--bg);transform:translateY(100%);transition:.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 22px calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));overflow-y:auto}
#fp.show{transform:none}
#fp:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:var(--fpbg,none) center/cover;filter:blur(60px) saturate(1.6);opacity:.38}
#fp .top{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;max-width:480px}
.vinyl{width:min(72vw,300px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;margin:26px auto 22px;position:relative;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle,#15121f 0 2px,#1d1a2a 2px 4px);box-shadow:0 30px 70px -20px var(--a1),0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 22%,transparent);animation:spin 9s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused}
.vinyl.on{animation-play-state:running}
.vinyl img{position:absolute;inset:23%;width:54%;height:54%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:4px solid #0d0b16}
.vinyl:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:47%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg)}
.vinyl:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 30deg,transparent 0 40deg,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 60deg,transparent 80deg 220deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 240deg,transparent 260deg)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.fpt{font-size:21px;font-weight:900;text-align:center;line-height:1.5;max-width:480px}
.fpa{color:var(--mut);text-align:center;margin-top:4px;font-size:14px}
.prog{width:100%;max-width:480px;margin:22px 0 4px}
input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a1) var(--p,0%),var(--ln) var(--p,0%));outline:0;direction:ltr}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 35%,transparent)}
.tm{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;direction:ltr;margin-top:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;margin:14px 0;direction:ltr}
.pbig{width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));color:#fff;font-size:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 16px 36px -12px var(--a1)}
.pbig:active{transform:scale(.93)}
.cm{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--ln);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px}
.seek{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:7px;width:100%;max-width:480px;direction:ltr}
.seek button{padding:10px 0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800}
.seek button:active{background:var(--card2)}
.seek button.f{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--a2) 80%,var(--txt))}
.seek button.b{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--a3) 80%,var(--txt))}
.ldr{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid var(--ln);border-top-color:var(--a1);border-right-color:var(--a2);animation:spin .9s linear infinite}
/* groups */
.gcard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln)}
.gav{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:20px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));flex:none}
.live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ok)}
.live:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--ok);animation:pulse 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px transparent}}
.gp-art{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.gp-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.gp-art .eq{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:14px;display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-end;height:26px}
.eq i{width:4px;border-radius:3px;background:#fff;animation:eq 1s ease-in-out infinite;opacity:.9}
.eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.4s}.eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-.7s}.eq i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-.2s}
@keyframes eq{0%,100%{height:5px}50%{height:24px}}
.eq.off i{animation-play-state:paused}
.vol{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:12px 0}
.note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);text-align:center;margin:8px 0}
/* cinema */
.screen{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#000;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 40%,transparent),0 30px 80px -10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 70%,transparent)}
.screen iframe,.screen #yt{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
.scov{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;text-align:center;padding:16px;font-weight:800;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 35%,#000),#000 75%);color:#fff;z-index:3}
.scov.tap{background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);cursor:pointer}
.curt{position:relative;padding:14px 12px 0;border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a3) 30%,transparent),transparent 40%);}
.curt:before,.curt:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:30%;width:14px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a3) 70%,#300),color-mix(in srgb,var(--a3) 40%,#200) 4px);border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;opacity:.8}
.curt:before{left:-2px}.curt:after{right:-2px}
.cinfo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:12px 4px 2px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.cinfo b{color:var(--txt);font-size:14.5px;flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.hall{margin-top:16px;perspective:600px}
.srow{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.srow.r2{transform:rotateX(14deg) scale(1.04)}
.seat{width:58px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mut);transition:.2s}
.seat .ch{width:52px;height:46px;position:relative}
.seat .ch svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.seat .ch img,.seat .ch .ini{position:absolute;top:2px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.seat .ch .ini{display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:13px}
.seat.me .nm{color:var(--a3);font-weight:800}
.seat .nm{max-width:58px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.seat.free:active{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.ytg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}
.yti{border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);text-align:start}
.yti img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;background:#000}
.yti div{padding:7px 9px 9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.55;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.yti small{display:block;padding:0 9px 9px;color:var(--mut);font-size:11px;margin-top:-5px}
.cbar{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0 0;direction:ltr;flex-wrap:wrap}
/* me */
.prof{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px;border-radius:24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.prof:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 40%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--a2) 25%,transparent));z-index:-1}
.pav{width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:22px;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;flex:none}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.stat{padding:14px 8px;border-radius:20px;text-align:center}
.stat b{display:block;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.stat span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.lang{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:15px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:800;margin-top:22px}
#toast{position:fixed;top:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-30px);opacity:0;z-index:90;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:16px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg2) 92%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--ln);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;transition:.3s;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:var(--sh);max-width:90%;text-align:center}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.fade{animation:fade .35s ease}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
.skel{height:70px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--card),var(--card2),var(--card));background-size:200% 100%;animation:sk 1.2s infinite}
@keyframes sk{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.dis{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none}
.lgp{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -12px var(--a1)}
.orb{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);display:grid;place-items:center}
.orb:after{content:"";width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.65),transparent 45%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a1),var(--a2));box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--a1)}
.brand2{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15;direction:ltr;text-align:right}
.brand2 b{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-size:17px}
.brand2 i{font-style:normal;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a3),var(--a1),var(--a2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:28px;padding:18px;margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--a1) 85%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--a2) 75%,#000));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -24px var(--a1)}
